summary: Frontend-only responsive and editor-gate QA, read-only. I made no source changes and no real data writes. Public routes were replayed from the prod and preview fixtures (GET only, every non-GET aborted). I ran 8 public routes plus a field-note article at 320/390/768/1024/1280/1366 (Chromium, both fixture sets) with a new probe, /app/tests/iter28_probe.js. It measures real text-line rects and image bounds, not just scrollWidth, and checks offscreen text, ancestor clipping, text-on-text overlap, text-on-image overlap, section containment and footer collisions. WebKit 26 was installed in the test runner and also run on prod at 390/1024/1280/1440. RESULT: docW equals vw everywhere. No offscreen or clipped text below 1440, no text-text overlaps, no footer collisions. The saved prod --ed geometry that broke 1024/1280 is gone. Craft 'Knowledge Carried Forward' band is FIXED: it now shares the hero/footer rails, 50 to 1389 at 1440 and 290 to 1629 at 1920. Desktop 1440/1920 diff against responsive_desktop_baseline.json: 0 font changes on all 32 captures, docH identical, preview identical except Craft. FAILURES: (1) HIGH: prod Craft Centre text at 1440 in Chromium is still cut off, and worse (x=-183 now, -133 before). (2) HIGH: Workshops and Rakhigarhi photos with a saved --ed-h spill out of their figure below 1440 and cover the next heading and text (Chromium and WebKit). (3) HIGH: in the mobile/tablet menu, with the Our Work submenu expanded, tapping Field Notes or Connect does nothing. (4) Minor: uncoloured .hb-bg sections lost their saved +20px / +9px X offset at 1440. Editor gate PASSES. At 390/768/1024 and touch 1366, both cold ?edit=1 and stored session: no dock, no contentEditable, no live-editing class, 0 admin requests. Desktop 1280/1440/1920: editor opens, selection, inline typing, panel drag and save all work. Page, header and site drafts survive desktop to 390 to desktop, and the saves go only to QA stubs. Contact form, field-note dates and the modal pass.

ui_bugs.component: Craft Centre text (prod data) at 1440 in Chromium
ui_bugs.issue: Eyebrow, heading and body sit at x=-183 (baseline was -133) and are cut off by #public-site overflow, so about 183px of text is unreadable. The bounded 540px .split-text wrapper did apply (width 540, justify-self center, left at 110). But the children still carry a saved --ed-t translate(-293px, 312px), and the section lost its 20px X offset, so the text moved 50px further offscreen. At 1920 the text starts at x=65, outside the 290 rail. WebKit lays out the split grid differently (column 1229px, text column at 450), so there the text lands at x=157: the result depends on the browser.

ui_bugs.component: Photos with saved --ed-h below 1440 (prod data, Chromium and WebKit)
ui_bugs.issue: At <=1439 the figure keeps aspect-ratio 4/3 (or --ratio) via .photo.crop, while responsive.css lines 53-55 give the img aspect-ratio var(--ed-ar), which is the tall desktop box. The photo-frame and img are then taller than the figure and overlap the following text. Workshops 390: figure 215px, img 550px, covering 'Creative Exchange / New Ideas. New Directions.' and its paragraphs. Workshops block-4-collage-0: img 303 in a 138 figure at 390 (covers the 'Student Projects / Learning That Becomes a Contribution' heading); at 1366, img 639 in a 290 figure covers the 'Students can contribute' paragraph. Rakhigarhi block-2-detail-0 at 390: img 240 in a 203 figure covers the paragraph text.

With the Our Work submenu expanded, a click or tap on Field Notes or Connect does not navigate. Dropdown's document pointerdown handler (PublicLayout.jsx lines 19-23) closes the submenu on pointerdown, the list collapses by about 180px, and the click lands on whatever is now under the pointer. The menu stays open on the same page. Reproduced in Chromium (mouse and touch tap) and WebKit (touch tap) at 390. With the submenu collapsed, navigation works.

design_issues.screen: Desktop 1440 (prod and preview Craft, plus prod home/theatre/workshops/rakhigarhi)
issues: The rail rule body:not(.live-editing) main > div > .hb:is(.band,.hb-bg) { transform: translateY(var(--ed-y)) } also matches uncoloured .hb-bg sections and drops their saved X offset. On prod Craft, block-2/3/5/6/7-wrap move from x=20 to x=0 (block-2 now runs 0 to 1400, asymmetric). On preview Craft at 1440, blocks 2/3/5/6/7 move from x=9 to 0. Text shifts 9 to 20px. The brief only allowed changes for coloured sections. Fonts and heights are unchanged.

Inputs are 15px at 768 (16px only at <=760). iPad Safari does not zoom on focus, so this is fine for iPad, but it fails the '>=16px on mobile/tablet' wording if large phones in landscape (up to 932px) count.
The coloured block-0 band is inset 5-6px from the footer and hero rail (41 to 983 vs 36 to 988 at 1024).

action_items: Craft Centre at >=1440: neutralise or clamp the saved X translate on the children of #craft-centre .split-text, for example transform: translateY(var(--ed-y)) for the [data-edit] children, or clamp left >= the container rail. Also give the section back its saved X offset. Verify in Chromium that the eyebrow left edge is >= 50 at 1440 and >= 290 at 1920 (the WebKit grid differs; check both).

responsive.css (<=1439/touch): for figure.photo[style*='--ed-h'] set aspect-ratio:auto !important on the figure. Or make the img use the figure's --ratio or --ed-crop instead of --ed-ar, so the image never exceeds its figure. Re-check workshops block-3-image and block-4-collage-0 and rakhigarhi block-2-detail-0 at 390/768/1366.

PublicLayout Dropdown: don't collapse on pointerdown inside #main-menu in collapsed-nav mode, for example by using a click listener or ignoring events inside nav[aria-label=Main]. Or close the submenu only after navigation. Then retest a tap on nav-m-notes or nav-m-connect with the submenu open.
Limit the rail rule to coloured bands, or keep translateX for non-band .hb-bg sections, so the desktop baseline is preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: responsive.css line 15: the #craft-centre fix bounds only the wrapper. The saved per-element --ed-t X (-293px) is still applied, so the outcome depends on where each engine puts the grid column (Chromium -183, WebKit 157). A pixel translate authored on another column width cannot be fixed by width alone.
responsive.css lines 53-55: img aspect-ratio uses --ed-ar while the figure keeps the .photo.crop aspect-ratio; the frame is overflow:hidden but the figure is overflow visible, so the image spills.
responsive.css line 5: .hb-bg matches transparent sections too; the comment says 'Coloured section boundaries'.
LiveEditor: two GET /admin/pages/:key/live calls per desktop cold load (duplicate fetch, harmless).
The gate itself is correct: enabled (session) and on (viewport) are separate. sessionStorage usp-live-edit stays '1' on mobile without any UI or requests.

success_rate.frontend: about 82%. Editor gate 100%, contact, notes and modal 100%, menu 90% (submenu then lower-link tap fails), layout: 3 real issues across 144 Chromium plus 36 WebKit captures, Craft Centre still clipped

seed_data_creation: None. Every PUT/POST/DELETE was intercepted. QA-only stubs answered PUT /admin/pages/:key/live (echoing the payload), /admin/header-live and /admin/site-live; everything else non-GET was aborted. The 'QA' text typed in edits never reached the backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive sweep: in browser_automation run g={}; exec(open('/app/tests/iter28_sweep.py').read(), g); await g['run'](page, ['prod'], [390]). Emulate reduced_motion first; set g['OUT'] to change the output file. Desktop regression: run iter27_desktop_baseline.py (results in iter28_desktop_after.json), then python3 /app/tests/iter28_desktop_diff.py. Editor: g['run'](page) in iter28_editor_gate.py covers the gate; g['chrome_drafts'](page) covers header and site drafts. WebKit is now installed: from playwright.async_api import async_playwright; pw.webkit.launch(). In headless WebKit some prod images report complete=false; that is unverified, so check on a real Safari. Known probe false positive: /connect at 1440, 'Send message' is flagged as escaping block-0-wrap; it is visually fine. Desktop text-on-image overlays on the theatre and craft heroes above 1100 are by design.
rca of the issue: Image overlap: figure height comes from .photo.crop aspect-ratio (4/3 or --ratio), while the responsive img ratio comes from --ed-ar (the tall desktop box), so img height is greater than figure height. Menu: the pointerdown outside-handler on each Dropdown li fires for clicks on sibling menu items, collapsing the submenu before the click. Craft Centre: saved child translateX -293px plus the removed section X offset; the width-only wrapper fix does not cancel the translate.
